title.en: Stay on one row while resolving which pump prints a 5 m tight-site window
title.zh: 选型时不要并格：哪一台泵印了 5 米的狭小场地窗口

description.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. B500S-83D. Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists this two-stage manual/electric pump for short-reach sand and small stone: 7.5 kW, 380 V, delivery height 5 m, horizontal 5 m, materials 5–16 mm, standard hose, 915 × 550 × 550 mm and 280 kg. Keep this cell as published. The short boom is part of the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The selection guide puts it first for a 5 m small site.
description.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：B500S-83D。邢台河北品锦机械把这台两级手动/电动泵列为短距离砂与小石：7.5 kW、380 V、垂直 5 m、水平 5 m、材料 5–16 mm、标准胶管、外形 915 × 550 × 550 mm、280 kg。短臂架属于本机，不是车载布料杆。选型指南把 5 m 的小型工地放在它前面。

body.en: The section shape comes from “Efficiency” in “Gear pump”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Read it in the Xingtai table. B500S-83D: 7.5 kW, 380 V, 5 m height, 5 m horizontal, sand and small stone 5–16 mm, 280 kg. Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists this two-stage manual/electric pump for short-reach sand and small stone: 7.5 kW, 380 V, delivery height 5 m, horizontal 5 m, materials 5–16 mm, standard hose, 915 × 550 × 550 mm and 280 kg. Keep this cell as published. Height and horizontal distance are each 5 m. Taken from the printed row: Stone outside 5–16 mm also leaves this page. Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not describe B500S-83D as the off-grid compact pump. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Keep this cell as published. The catalogue says the short boom belongs to this compact unit. Taken from the printed row: It is the lightest pump weight cited on the selection-guide small-site question. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gear_pump
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Gear pump》的“效率”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。按邢台表上的原文理解：B500S-83D：7.5 kW、380 V、垂直 5 m、水平 5 m、砂与小石 5–16 mm、280 kg。短臂架不是车载布料杆。旁边那一台不在这句话里。没有柴油版 B500S 页面。没有 380 V 的狭小工地去看 17 kW 农村柴油泵或拖拉机带动4100，那两台更大，距离也更长。不要把 B500S-83D 写成无电网紧凑泵。这一格照已印出的读：不是。目录写明短臂架属于这台紧凑机。图来自来源页面：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gear_pump

body.en: “Gear pump” breaks its subject at “Applications”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. Taken from the printed row: The short boom is not a truck boom. Read it in the Xingtai table. The short boom is part of the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Electric 15 prints 15–20 m vertical and 60–80 m horizontal at 450 kg. Keep this cell as published. There is no diesel B500S page. Taken from the printed row: Confirm 380 V, 5 m / 5 m, and 5–16 mm stone. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue leaves that cell blank for. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. Keep this cell as published. Sprayers such as Type 311 print 150 kg and are not pumps.
body.zh: 《Gear pump》在“用途”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。B500S-83D。河北品锦机械（邢台）把这台两级手动/电动泵列为短距离砂与小石：7.5 kW、380 V、垂直 5 m、水平 5 m、材料 5–16 mm、标准胶管、外形 915 × 550 × 550 mm、280 kg。短臂架属于本机，不是车载布料杆。选型指南把 5 m 的小型工地放在它前面。按邢台表上的原文理解：请确认 380 V、5 m / 5 m，以及 5–16 mm 石子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。没有。那句话在电动15、电动10系列、农村柴油泵和 4100 上。

body.en: Borrow “Development” from “Gear pump” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Keep this cell as published. B500S-83D. Taken from the printed row: The selection guide puts it first for a 5 m small site. Read it in the Xingtai table. If the pipe is longer than 5 m, B500S-83D is no longer the row, even if the site feels tight. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. A tight site without 380 V looks at the 17 kW rural diesel or the tractor-driven 4100, which are larger and print longer distances. Keep this cell as published. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Taken from the printed row: No. Read it in the Xingtai table. That sentence is on Electric 15, Electric 10 Series, the rural diesel and the 4100.
body.zh: 把《Gear pump》的“发展”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。这一格照已印出的读：高度和水平都是 5 m。电动15印的是垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、450 kg。管路长于 5 m 时，即使场地显得狭小，也不再是 B500S-83D。石子超出 5–16 mm 同样离开这一页。目录里已经写着：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。按邢台表上的原文理解：它是选型指南小型工地问题里引用的最轻泵重。311 等喷涂机印了 150 kg，但它们不是泵。

question.en: “Efficiency” does not change the check: Is the boom a truck boom?
question.zh: “效率”不改这一问：臂架是车载布料杆吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. No. The catalogue says the short boom belongs to this compact unit.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：不是。目录写明短臂架属于这台紧凑机。

question.en: Does it print secondary structure, once the outline says “Applications”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“用途”时，它印了二次结构吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: No. That sentence is on Electric 15, Electric 10 Series, the rural diesel and the 4100.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：没有。那句话在电动15、电动10系列、农村柴油泵和 4100 上。

question.en: Under “Development”, is 280 kg the lightest listed pump?
question.zh: 在“发展”这一节里，280 kg 是列出的最轻泵吗？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. It is the lightest pump weight cited on the selection-guide small-site question. Sprayers such as Type 311 print 150 kg and are not pumps.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：它是选型指南小型工地问题里引用的最轻泵重。311 等喷涂机印了 150 kg，但它们不是泵。
